fullDescription: A bright, glossy "wall of love" testimonial section in a candy-sky Frutiger-Aero register: a cyan-to-pastel sky gradient into white clouds, a heavy rounded-black headline, glossy inflated candy-pill accents, and a masonry grid of mixed-format quote cards. Reusable for any SaaS, dev-tool, or consumer-app social-proof section that wants a playful, high-energy alternative to flat glassmorphism or muted editorial testimonials.
prompt:
## Resumo
A full-page testimonial 'wall of love' social-proof section for a SaaS/dev-tool product, built in a bright candy-sky glossy register (a Frutiger-Aero/Y2K-adjacent material system). It opens on a full-bleed sky gradient (cyan-blue fading through pastel pink/lavender into fluffy white clouds) carrying a heavy rounded-black headline ('Loved by builders everywhere.'), a 5-avatar cluster, a 5-star rating line, and a 'Trusted by 4,800+ teams' line. A cloud-shaped SVG divider transitions into a wordmark-only logo strip (5 invented company names, each in a distinct typographic treatment, grayscale-dim with full-ink hover). Below, a masonry grid of 11 quote cards on a calm off-white canvas mixes plain star-rating cards, X/tweet-style handle cards, a 'Verified' badge card, and one oversized spotlight quote with a large glossy pink quote-mark glyph; a few cards carry a rationed glossy candy-pill accent (a colored badge or border). It closes on a second sky-gradient band with a headline and one signature fat glossy orange candy-pill CTA button (rounded ~40px, inner white highlight sweep, soft colored drop shadow, looks inflated/plastic).

## Estilo Visual
Use a full-bleed vertical sky gradient (cyan-blue #75e6ff at the top, fading through pale candy pastels #fff0f0 / #fef0ff / #fff7f0 / #eeebff / #f6ebff into white #ffffff) for the top proof band and the closing CTA band only. Keep the middle 'wall' section on a calm off-white #fbfaff canvas so the page doesn't read as maximalist. Use ONE heavy ROUNDED display font (e.g. 'M PLUS Rounded 1c' at ExtraBold/Black) for every headline, and a clean neutral sans (Inter) for body/UI. Ink is near-black #0f101a, never pure #000. Any accent button, chip, or badge uses the signature glossy-candy-pill recipe: a solid saturated fill (warm orange #ff8a00 or hot magenta-pink #ff54bb), an inner soft-white highlight sweep (rgba(255,255,255,.55-.6) top-biased), and a soft colored drop shadow, so it looks inflated/plastic. Do NOT use backdrop-blur or frosted glass anywhere. Ration the two accent hues; most surfaces stay white/pale/near-black.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Proof band
Full-bleed sky-gradient section (cyan-blue at top fading through pastels to white). Centered: a heavy rounded-black display headline (2 lines, ~56-64px), a horizontal cluster of 5 overlapping circular avatars, a 5-star rating row, and a small line 'Trusted by 4,800+ teams.' Keep vertical padding tight; this band should not dominate the page.

### Cloud divider + logo strip
A fluffy white-cloud SVG shape (proper viewBox) transitions the sky gradient into a plain white section. Below it, a small tracked-caps label ('POWERING NEXT-GEN STARTUPS') over a single row of 5 invented company wordmarks (no icon glyphs or shape placeholders standing in for logos), each set in a genuinely distinct typographic treatment (different weight, case, and letter-spacing per name) so the row reads as a deliberate type specimen. Grayscale/dim by default, full ink color on hover.

### Masonry testimonial wall
A 3-column masonry grid (single column on mobile) of 11 quote cards on a calm off-white canvas, mixed formats: several plain white cards with a 5-star row + quote + small avatar/name/role; a couple of X/tweet-style cards (handle, avatar, an X-glyph icon, casual lowercase copy); one 'Verified' badge card (a small glossy magenta-pink pill badge top-right); one card with a rationed orange top-border accent; and one oversized spotlight card with a large glossy pink quote-mark glyph and a longer, larger-type testimonial. All names, roles, and companies are invented; no real people or brands are used.

### Closing CTA band
A second full-bleed sky-gradient band. A heavy rounded-black headline ('Ready to join them?'), a short subhead, and one signature fat glossy candy-pill CTA button: solid warm orange fill, ~40px border radius, generous height, inner soft-white highlight sweep near the top edge, soft orange drop shadow so it looks inflated, white rounded-semibold label with a trailing arrow.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Glossy candy-pill button/chip — The material signature of this build: any accent surface (CTA button, stat chip, badge) reads as inflated glossy plastic rather than flat color or frosted glass.
A pill shape (border-radius ~40px or fully rounded) with a solid saturated fill color, an inner highlight created by a radial or linear white gradient biased toward the top edge (opacity ~0.55-0.6, fading to transparent by the vertical midpoint), and a soft colored drop-shadow (same hue as the fill, low opacity, moderate blur and y-offset) so the shape reads as inflated/pressurized plastic, not flat and not glassy.

### Cloud-transition SVG divider — A fluffy white-cloud silhouette that transitions the sky-gradient band into the plain white/pale section below it.
A full-width SVG with a proper viewBox matching its coordinate space: a horizontal band of overlapping rounded/cloud-like bump shapes in solid white, positioned at the bottom edge of the sky-gradient section so it reads as clouds meeting the section below.

### Wordmark-only logo strip — A trust strip using typographic lockups instead of icon/shape placeholders, so it reads as real company names rather than lorem-ipsum filler.
A single row of 5 invented company names, each set as pure typography with NO icon or shape glyph: vary weight, case (upper/lower/mixed), and letter-spacing distinctly per name so each reads as its own logo lockup. Default state dim/grayscale (e.g. reduced opacity or a gray filter); on hover, full ink color.
